name: gs-config-template
description: Google Apps Script template for Google Sheets config: EF Core-style migrations, typed sheet schemas, plugin system, health dashboard.
author: Denis Cuciuc

scripts.lint: biome check src/ examples/ test/ scripts/
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src/ examples/ test/ scripts/
scripts.lint:ci: biome ci src/ examples/ test/ scripts/
scripts.format: biome format --write src/ examples/ test/ scripts/
scripts.ci: pnpm lint:ci && pnpm test:ci && pnpm build && pnpm build:example
